name: 69301 · Alliance, NE
findings: ZIP 69301 (Alliance) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 69301 (Alliance) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 69301 (Alliance) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
